preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input (T, N, Q, A[i], P[i], x, y) are within bounds 1 ≤ value ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and ' '.join(line.split()) != '1 2 3 1')
preconditions.description: For each test case, array A and P have exactly N elements each, matching the given N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == N for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' '.join(line.split()) in [' '.join(map(str, A)), ' '.join(map(str, P))])
preconditions.description: Arrays A and P are permutations of 1..N (all distinct elements from 1 to N).

preconditions.expression: all(' '.join(line.split()) == '1' or ' '.join(line.split()) == '2 x y' or ' '.join(line.split()) == '3 x' for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip().isdigit() == False and ' '.join(line.split()) not in [' '.join(map(str, A)), ' '.join(map(str, P))])
preconditions.description: Each operation line is either '1', '2 x y' (with x ≠ y), or '3 x'.

preconditions.expression: all(int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('2') and (x := line.split()[1]) and (y := line.split()[2]))

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(A_after_operations[x - 1]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() and (x := int(stdout_line.split()[0]) if ' '.join(stdout_line.split()) == '3 x' else None))
postconditions.description: For each type 3 operation '3 x', the output line is the element at position x in the current array A after all preceding operations have been applied.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '' for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() and not any(op.startswith('3') for op in stdin.splitlines() if op.strip() == stdout_line.strip()))
postconditions.description: Only output lines corresponding to type 3 operations are produced, with no extra lines.
